title: Normalized class adjunction at a specified etale adjoint
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring, $f:X\to Y$ a quasi-compact morphism of schemes, $c_0$ a compactification [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], and $F_{c_0}^{et}\dashv G$ a specified ordinary etale compact-support adjunction [def-amb-etale-compact-support]. Let $\nu_T$ be site comparison [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. Suppose $G R\nu_{Y,*}L$ is bounded below for every bounded-below $L$. Then the normalized class-relative adjunction data of [thm-sf-ambient-adjoint-class] exist for this very $G$ and this very adjunction: on bounded-below etale-origin inputs and bounded-below targets the Hom bijections are normalized by that adjunction, the fixed compact-support comparison and comparison adjunction; the compactification comparisons retain their canonical normalization, identity, cocycle and Hom-compatibility laws. This conclusion asserts neither preservation of constructibility nor of finite Tor amplitude.

source.place: Displayed Hom chain and final paragraph; retain the supplied ordinary etale adjoint and its normalization.

proof.text: For each bounded-below etale representative compose the fixed compact-support comparison, the comparison adjunction, the supplied ordinary-etale adjunction, and full faithfulness of comparison pullback on its bounded-below target. The lower-bound hypothesis is exactly what the last step needs. Descend these natural Hom bijections along the equivalence onto the full subcategory of bounded-below etale-origin objects. This is representativeHomEquiv followed by comparisonHomDescent in the existing source of the helper.

Transport the canonical etale compactification comparisons along the same full equivalence. Full faithfulness preserves and reflects their naturality, identity and cocycle equalities; composing the normalized Hom chain gives Hom-compatibility. The already proved private buildFixedComparisonClassAdjunction carries exactly these data for arbitrary finite Lambda, G and adj. Apply it and introduce Nonempty.

lean.statement:
theorem nonempty_fixedComparisonClassAdjunction_of_boundedBelow
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} [QuasiCompact f] (c₀ : Compactification f)
    (G : _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) ⥤
      _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)))
    (adj : Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) c₀ ⊣ G)
    (hG : ∀ L, _root_.DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.plus L →
      _root_.DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.plus
        (G.obj (R(ν_*(Y)[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj L))) :
    Nonempty (FixedComparisonClassAdjunction Λ f c₀ G adj
      (DerivedCategory.plusEtaleOrigin (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) X)
      _root_.DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.plus)
